name: Gemini CLI
description: Google's terminal AI agent that uses Gemini to read and edit code, run shell commands, search the web and automate developer workflows.
whatItDoes: Gemini CLI lets developers talk to Gemini from the terminal to explore and change codebases, generate new projects, run commands and automate repository chores. It also works non-interactively for scripting, with plain, JSON or streaming JSON output.
howItWorks: A Node.js CLI runs an agent loop against Gemini models with built-in tools for file operations, shell execution, web fetch and Google Search grounding. Additional tools are attached through MCP servers. Authentication is via Google sign-in, a Gemini API key, or Vertex AI.

requirements.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Gemini API key; alternative to signing in with a Google account

requirements.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
requirements.description: Vertex AI key, used together with GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
requirements.description: Cloud project for Code Assist licence users
